title: private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-04-06
content:
Weekly sync (prep / notes)
Date: 2026-04-06
Owner (notes): Sofia Chen (eng-private-deployments)
Attendees (expected): Alex Morales (solutions eng), Priya Nair (customer success), Jamal Reed (acme infra lead), Michael Ortiz (acme security) - confirm final attendee list before meeting
Goal for this sync: unblock VPC peering and get green on infra smoke tests. Short session (30m): 10m updates, 15m blockers/decisions, 5m action items

Quick status snapshot (what I will say):
- Private control plane: deployed to acme-dev (v1.2.1), control-plane logs showing steady heartbeats, RBAC configured
- Dedicated nodepools: 3 worker pools provisioned (gpu-small x2, general-purpose x3) - GPU quota close to limit in acme prod account
- Networking: VPC peering request submitted on 2026-04-02; acme network blocking egress to our metrics collector; need final CIDR confirmation
- KMS/HSM: KMS key created in acme-managed KMS, but IAM role binding failing during test decrypt (401)
- Certs: TLS cert rotation on staging passed; production cert provisioning delayed pending SAN entry from acme-security
- Smoke tests: image pull + startup okay, but KV cache hits low on first sequence (looks like init path mismatch)

Milestones (near-term) - status and owners:
1) VPC peering + routing (M1) - target: 2026-04-09 - owner: Jamal Reed (acme) + Alex Morales (RWI)
   - Current: Peering request pending acceptance; acme needs to add route to metrics subnet
   - Blocker: acme firewall policy currently denies outbound to 10.8.0.0/16 (our metrics collector)

2) KMS integration smoke (M2) - target: 2026-04-08 - owner: Priya Nair (RWI) + Michael Ortiz (acme)
   - Current: Key exists, decrypt attempt returns 401 (role binding); acme to confirm trust relationship and service account email
   - Blocker: missing iam:decrypt permission for service-account@redwood-infra. Will need acme to grant or we switch to customer-managed service account

3) Nodepool autoscaling config (M3) - target: 2026-04-12 - owner: Sofia Chen
   - Current: autoscaler configured but scale-down too aggressive in integration tests -> flaps under burst load
   - Action: increase stabilizationWindow to 300s, tune CPU thresholds; run load test tomorrow

4) Cert SAN and rotation (M4) - target: 2026-04-07 - owner: Alex Morales
   - Current: cert request pending SAN list from acme-security
   - Blocker: acme-security needs to approve allowing wildcard for internal hostnames

5) Smoke test regressions (M5) - target: 2026-04-09 - owner: Sofia Chen + Eng-oncall
   - Current: first-token latency good; KV cache misses on startup causing token explosion for some prompts
   - Investigation: likely a key-prefix mismatch in cache init (PR #412) - low risk but increases cost; patch in review

Open blockers / discussion topics for meeting:
- Firewall / egress policy: acme currently blocks our metrics/telemetry. Need to decide whether to route metrics via a proxy inside acme network (they prefer) or request allowlist for our endpoint. (Decision needed: proxy vs allowlist)
- IAM trust for KMS: ask acme to confirm service account email and grant iam:decrypt. If they cannot, propose alternate flow to use acme-managed short-lived credentials.
- Quota: acme-prod GPU quota at 8/10; consider temporary burst request or move some jobs to dedicated pool in our cloud. Need decision on whether to file quota request now (impact timeline if wait).
- Test flakiness: autoscaler flaps + cache init. Decide on temporary knob (stabilizationWindow) to push green smoke tests, then follow up with proper fix.

Planned asks from acme during sync (be explicit):
- Accept VPC peering and push route for 10.8.0.0/16 to metrics cluster by EOD 2026-04-07 (owner: Jamal)
- Confirm KMS service account/email and grant iam:decrypt by 2026-04-08 (owner: Michael)
- Provide SAN list for certs OR approve internal wildcard by 2026-04-07 (owner: Michael)
- Confirm GPU quota increase request timeline or agree to move non-critical workloads to dev pool by 2026-04-09 (owner: Jamal)

Action items (capture during meeting) - format: item | owner | due
- If acme accepts peering today, coordinate route push and run metrics end-to-end test | Alex Morales | 2026-04-07
- Validate KMS decrypt with provided SA; if 401 persists, fallback plan to use short-lived creds | Priya Nair | 2026-04-08
- Apply autoscaler stabilizationWindow tweak on integration cluster and re-run smoke tests | Sofia Chen | 2026-04-07
- Prepare short explainer for acme-security about cert SAN implications and ask for approval | Alex Morales | 2026-04-06 (before sync)
- File GPU quota request with cloud provider if acme cannot increase quota by 2026-04-08 | Jamal Reed / RWI infra | 2026-04-09
- Merge PR #412 (cache init fix) after one more unit test pass; coordinate rollback plan | Sofia Chen | 2026-04-09

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Remember to mention that Dedicated pool can be used as temporary buffer for spikes (cost talk + SLA implications)
- Keep language non-technical when talking to acme-security; provide clear audit trail and KMS flow diagram (attach to Confluence)
- Bring up telemetry proxy option only if acme resists allowlist (they prefer internal-only traffic)
- Check with SRE on cert auto-rotation schedule before promising dates

Risks & mitigation (for CSM / exec update):
- Risk: KMS binding delays -> prevents access to encrypted model weights in prod -> mitigation: short-lived creds + low-risk testing path
- Risk: Network egress policy blocks -> unable to debug in prod -> mitigation: telemetry proxy and additional logging in agent
- Risk: GPU quota shortage -> mitigation: burst pooling and cost estimate for temporary uplift

Follow-ups after meeting (post-sync checklist):
- Update Confluence status table and move items to "in_progress" where applicable
- Create/update Jira tickets for any new tasks (prefix: JIRA-OPS) and link to this doc
- Email summary to acme stakeholders and internal RWI execs (copy CSM and sales)

References / previous weekly notes:
- private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-03-30 (smoke test notes)
- private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-03-23 (networking history)

Meeting prep TODOs (before 09:00 PT on 2026-04-06):
- Ping Jamal to confirm peering acceptance window (Sofia)
- Draft short KMS checklist (Priya)
- Attach PR #412 test results to Confluence (Sofia)

End of notes. Will copy action items into meeting minutes during sync.
